phase_2_numeric_role.limit: Context classifier plus deterministic clause relation binding; not learned coreference.

phase_3_execution_graph.limit: At most 64 nodes and branch depth 3; natural-language condition grammar bounded.

phase_4_world_state.evidence: WorldState.graph and state mutation integration test
phase_4_world_state.limit: Task-local arithmetic state, not an open-domain simulator; scheduling is sequential.

phase_5_verification.limit: Independent arithmetic/constraints; cannot guarantee that a plausible semantic parse matches user intent.

phase_6_reflection.limit: At most two retries; repairs calculation state or reparses slots, not arbitrary self-improvement.

phase_7_sequence.limit: Finite observed sequences are generally non-unique; unsupported patterns abstain; fresh misses remain.

phase_8_probability.evidence: binomial exact/at-least/at-most; dice; counting; independent probabilities

phase_9_code.evidence: code_intent_v20.npz; ten verified recipes; retained legacy tracing/debugging
phase_9_code.limit: No broad new code-generation/refactor/debugging model. Fresh code generation remains weak.

phase_10_persian.evidence: word-number/morphographic normalization and bilingual supervised corpus
phase_10_persian.limit: No new conversational-language transformer training; translation and rewrite scores did not improve.

phase_11_rag.evidence: self-contained protection, deduplication, support filtering, 12 bilingual concepts
phase_11_rag.limit: Not broad multilingual dense retrieval; no new large knowledge corpus.

phase_12_web.evidence: duplicate-mirror corroboration correction; existing multi-source pipeline preserved
phase_12_web.limit: Live internet quality not measured; only freshness/routing tested offline.

core_neural_continual_training.reason: CPU-only environment without PyTorch; existing transformer checkpoint preserved. This is optional under the task's hardware condition, not claimed as a neural-core upgrade.

dataset_volume.reason: 60k-120k was a quality-dependent suggestion; no inflated numeric-template expansion is claimed.

official_index.reason: The supplied archive does not contain the executable JARVIS-INTELLIGENCE-INDEX-v1 rubric or its weights. Fresh benchmark percentages are not substituted for it.
